    • getAvailableViewsAsOptions

      default Map<String,I18nString> getAvailableViewsAsOptions(boolean isTabbed, boolean isPrimary)
      Gets all tabbed or non-tabbed views
      Parameters:
      isTabbed - if true, only tabbed views will be returned
      isPrimary - if true, only views accessible directly from the menu_item will be returned
      Returns:
      All available views defined in MenuItemView in consideration of input value. Views are returned as options for
      invalid reference 
      MapOptionsField

    • getAvailableViewsAsOptions

      default Map<String,I18nString> getAvailableViewsAsOptions(boolean isTabbed, String viewIdentifier)
      Gets all tabbed or non-tabbed views
      Parameters:
      isTabbed - if true, only tabbed views will be returned
      viewIdentifier - identifier of view (defined in MenuItemView), which is parent to returned views
      Returns:
      All available views defined in MenuItemView in consideration of input values. Views are returned as options for
      invalid reference 
      MapOptionsField
